fact: ITWeb reports BoFiNet's launch of the Digital Delta Internet Exchange Point, where ISPs, mobile operators, content and cloud providers are to exchange local traffic directly; no launch date or member count is given, so as_of is the article date 2026-10-06.

PeeringDB lists Digital Delta IX in Gaborone, operated from a BoFiNet facility, with 10G capacity and one peer (BoFiNet's own ASN 37678), so no second network is yet shown exchanging traffic; record last updated 2026-04-21.
The PCH directory lists the Botswana Internet Exchange (BINX), Gaborone, established October 2005, with status Defunct and no subnets, switches or contacts listed; as_of is the 2025 directory date.

Mmegi reports BoFiNet relocated the Gaborone IXP to a more secure and resilient environment as part of a P100m gateway upgrade; no members or traffic are given, and as_of is the article date 2025-04-16 as no relocation date is stated.

BOCRA's newsletter says the Botswana Internet Exchange (BINX), established by the Internet Service Providers Association, continues to play a vital role in local Internet infrastructure; it describes a stakeholder workshop held at BOCRA on 15 October 2025, and notes financial sustainability, outdated equipment and governance delays.
BOCRA's newsletter says BINX supports local Internet infrastructure through its Google Cache Cluster and a Packet Clearing House node.
